date.description: Pin this date for reproducible JSON-LD metadata; otherwise the local build date is used.

canonical_url.description: Published URL of this dashboard for JSON-LD provenance. Default: <slug>.html (relative).

publisher_url.description: JSON-LD publisher org URL. Default: the rapidmeta-kit Pages site.

orcid.description: Author ORCID (id or full URL). Omit to drop the empty identifier.

repo.description: owner/repo cited in the help text. Default: mahmood726-cyber/rapidmeta-kit.

nct.description: Unique registry ID. Auto-linked ONLY for recognized formats (NCT########, ISRCTN########, ACTRN##############). Other IDs require an explicit sourceUrl.

sourceUrl.description: Absolute HTTP(S) primary-source/registry URL. REQUIRED for trial IDs not auto-linked by clone.py.

reportedEffectType.description: Required whenever any publishedHR/pubHR field is supplied. Confirm in the paper that the reported effect is truly a hazard ratio; odds/risk/rate ratios cannot be input through this path.

kmAnchors.description: OPTIONAL registry KM anchors for survival/pseudo-IPD reconstruction (registry-ipd engine). Shape: { time_unit, arms:[{arm_id,label,role,N,total_events,follow_up_max,km_points:[{t,S}],median}], hr }. Omit entirely for non-survival reviews — the Survival/Pseudo-IPD panel stays hidden and inert when absent.
